facts.fact: Elowen 在手术中继续打趣 Micah 对 Lucan 的心思。
facts.anchor: “You’re hopeless, Doc,” Elowen says, passing me a pair of sterile forceps.

facts.fact: Micah 为老 hellhound 完成手术缝合。
facts.anchor: The curved needle passes cleanly through the skin.

facts.fact: Micah 下班到铁匠铺带来 Maple 翅膀的 X 光片。
facts.anchor: I slide the X-ray from the folder and carry it over to the window.

facts.fact: Lucan 提议以残存骨骼与关节为义翅框架的锚点。
facts.anchor: “What if we anchor the frame here?”

facts.fact: Lucan 指导 Micah 在熔炉旁锻造，两人的身体接近。
facts.anchor: Lucan moves behind me. His broad chest settles warmly against my back

facts.fact: Maple 一周内长重五磅，诊所笼舍将不够用。
facts.anchor: It’s only been a week since I found her, and she’s already put on five pounds.

facts.fact: Micah 与四处旅行的父亲通话。
facts.anchor: My father is a traveling merchant

facts.fact: Micah 表示没有舞会伴侣，拒绝父亲的撮合。
facts.anchor: “No, Dad. I don’t have a date.”

facts.fact: Micah 独自归家时以南瓜造伴侣的传说自嘲约会之难。
facts.anchor: Carving a lover out of a pumpkin sounds a hell of a lot easier.
